propositions: A new plan-review LLM criterion ac-process-gate must flag acceptance criteria that are generic, ticket-agnostic process/tooling gates (e.g. 'all tests pass', 'CI is green', 'children are closed') that CI or rebar enforce mechanically for every ticket, while accepting ACs that name this ticket's specific deliverable.

The ac-process-gate criterion must be registered in registry.CANONICAL_LLM as a non-code-grounded, single-turn (1-TURN) advisory criterion with facet ac-text-quality, container+leaf scope, and a two-key checklist routing entry in criteria_routing.json.

The rubric prompt (plan_review_ac_process_gate.md) must document the reject-set (children-closed, tests/CI/build/lint pass, plan-review passes, merged/landed, DCO present) and accept-set (ACs naming specific deliverables), apply the 'reads identically on unrelated ticket' litmus, and enforce err-toward-silence to avoid false positives.

The bounded-sanity eval (plan-review-ac-process-gate.eval.yaml) must contain 2–8 cases with ≥2 fire examples (process-gate ACs) and ≥2 pass examples (deliverable ACs), achieving recall=1.0 and zero false accepts.

The registered criteria_routing.json entry and regenerated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md must pass registry validation (validate_packaged_routing, validate_criteria_guide returning []), and the deterministic unit tests must verify registration, routing, checklist, front-matter, and guide invariants.

The chunk_by_facet packer, which was tipped into a singleton trailing chunk by the 25th criterion, must be refactored to guarantee balanced near-equal contiguous chunks (guaranteed [2,size] for n≥2) with no hard-coded criterion COUNT in docs or registry docstring.
